defects.split remainder off by one: Split uses Amount(i) <= rem, so one extra cent goes to the part after the remainder, and the parts sum to more than total.
defects.post appends duplicates: Post appends the entry to the entries slice before the duplicate-ID check, so a repeated ID is stored twice and Balance counts it twice.
defects.balance includes to: Balance uses !After(to), so entries dated exactly at to are included, although to is supposed to be exclusive.
defects.accrue truncates: Accrue computes integer division balance*bps/10000, which truncates toward zero instead of rounding half to even to the cent.
defects.daily uses local zone: Daily formats e.Date without UTC(), so the day key is the local calendar date of the entry, not the UTC day.

decoys.decoy balance predicate reorder: Reordering the Balance predicate to test the date bounds before the account changes which entries are summed, because the account test is no longer the first check.
decoys.decoy daily accumulate rewrite: Rewriting days[day] += e.Amount as days[day] = days[day] + e.Amount changes the daily totals for days with more than one entry.
decoys.decoy zero rate guard removed: Removing the bps == 0 early return from Accrue changes results when the rate is zero, because the function then computes interest from the balance even at a zero rate.
